newsitem.title: UK: Britain seeks views on private security plans.
newsitem.headline: Britain seeks views on private security plans.

text.p: The British government said on Monday it was seeking views from over 70 organisations on ways to regulate the private security industry.
Home Office Minister Alun Michael said he had written a consultation letter seeking industry comment on the Labour Government's plans to regulate private security companies.
"Regulation will enable the public to have confidence in the quality of service and reliability of the private security industry as a whole," he said in a statement.
The consultation period will end on October 1.
